Specification: This module is a lightweight wrapper around another specification, intended to provide Apalache type annotations for a barrier specification instantiated from the module Barrier. It declares a constant N and a variable pc, and locally redefines the tuple vars as << pc >> in order to disambiguate the type of the 1-tuple used by the instantiated specification. The file itself contains no transition relation, temporal specification, or proof obligations; its main design purpose is to attach tool-specific typing information while leaving the original Barrier module unchanged.
